ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Alfred Herbert (India) Limited has announced Friday, August 21, 2026, as the record date for determining shareholder eligibility for the dividend for the financial year ended March 31, 2026. Shareholders holding shares by this date will qualify for the dividend, subject to approval at the Annual General Meeting on August 28, 2026, with payment expected on or after August 31, 2026. This document is a routine corporate disclosure regarding dividend entitlement and does not present any apparent red flags.
